current_news.title: Interim committees finish bill drafts before the 2027 General Session
current_news.summary: Panels finish drafts before Jan. 12. Education meets Nov. 17. Blockchain meets Nov. 19-20. Council meets Nov. 23.

special.title: Certified election results set the calendar for the 2027 Legislature
special.summary: The board certified the Nov. 3 results on Nov. 10. Officers take office Jan. 4, 2027. The Legislature convenes Jan. 12.
